exposure: Treatment strategies for Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP) subtypes
CSP classification methods (existing and newly proposed)
Vascular pretreatment methods (UAE, permanent vascular ligation, temporary vascular occlusion)
outcome: Management appropriateness for different CSP subtypes
cohort: A cohort of 1248 patients diagnosed with Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP) from a tertiary medical center.
finding: The study revealed a 95.5% success rate across treatment protocols, and that the newly proposed CSP classification (Liu classification) led to more appropriate treatment strategies for different CSP subtypes compared to existing methods.
